theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  have sub_l : ∀ a b : List Expression.Ident, (a ++ [h1]).Subset (a ++ (b ++ [h1])) :=
    fun a b x h => match List.mem_append.mp h with
    | .inl ha => List.mem_append_left _ ha
    | .inr h1 => List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_right _ h1)
  have sub_r : ∀ a b : List Expression.Ident, (b ++ [h1]).Subset (a ++ (b ++ [h1])) :=
    fun a b x h => List.mem_append_right _ h
  induction post <;> simp [substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
  case fvar => exact fun _ h => List.mem_append_left _ h
  case abs ih => exact ih
  case app ih1 ih2 =>
    split
    · split
      · exact fun _ h => List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_right _ h)
      · intro x h
        cases List.mem_append.mp h with
        | inl ha => exact List.mem_append_left _ ha
        | inr hb => exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_left _ hb)
    · exact List.Subset.app (List.Subset.trans ih1 (sub_l _ _)) (List.Subset.trans ih2 (sub_r _ _))
  case quant trih eih =>
    exact List.Subset.app (List.Subset.trans trih (sub_l _ _)) (List.Subset.trans eih (sub_r _ _))
  case eq ih1 ih2 =>
    exact List.Subset.app (List.Subset.trans ih1 (sub_l _ _)) (List.Subset.trans ih2 (sub_r _ _))
  case ite cih tih eih =>
    intro x h
    cases List.mem_append.mp h with
    | inl hc =>
      cases List.mem_append.mp (cih hc) with
      | inl hc => exact List.mem_append_left _ hc
      | inr h1 => exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_right _ h1))
    | inr hte =>
      cases List.mem_append.mp hte with
      | inl ht =>
        cases List.mem_append.mp (tih ht) with
        | inl ht => exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_left _ ht)
        | inr h1 => exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_right _ h1))
      | inr he =>
        cases List.mem_append.mp (eih he) with
        | inl he => exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_left _ he))
        | inr h1 => exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_right _ h1))
